provenance.midc: MIDC Pune Zone map layer 6 + industrial-area table 22 (gis.midcindia.org). Estate boundaries and plot status; not a company or emissions registry.
provenance.osm: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Partial snapshot: 551 points from 1 of 4 tiles; 3 tiles failed. Candidate site references, not a verified factory list.
provenance.emissionFactors: ARAI/TERI for MPCB, Emission Inventory for Pune District (2022), Table 7 p.23. Source units preserved.
provenance.districtEmissions: ARAI/TERI Pune inventory, Table 14 p.42. District aggregate tonnes/year for 2021; not allocated to estates or sites.
provenance.era5: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo, 2024–2025 hourly, 0.25° grid. Seasonal medians; modelled, not station measurements.
